rows.behavior: the hermes-interactive workflow is gone and nothing outside .loop/ refers to it
rows.fails_when: git tracks .github/workflows/hermes-interactive.yaml, or git grep finds 'hermes-interactive' in any tracked file outside .loop/

rows.behavior: the OLLAMA_API_KEY secret is still used by claude-ollama, so removing hermes leaves no orphaned secret to delete

rows.fails_when: just pre_commit or the cli test suite exits non-zero
rows.command: just pre_commit && uv run --directory cli pytest -q
